assumptions.statement: The platform team has sufficient Kafka operational expertise to manage MSK.
assumptions.quote: Two engineers on the platform team, Marcus Oyelaran and Jin Park, have run Kafka in production at previous companies, so we would not be starting from zero on operations.

assumptions.statement: The system must be able to replay at least seven days of shipment events for all consumers.
assumptions.quote: Tracking, billing and notifications all need to replay the last seven days of shipment events after a bad deploy; last month a billing bug required a manual re‑send of 2.3 million events from database snapshots, which took a weekend.

assumptions.statement: Kinesis retention cost and limited fan‑out make it unsuitable for the required replay window.
assumptions.quote: Kinesis was rejected because extended retention is priced per shard‑hour and consumer fan‑out is limited without enhanced fan‑out.

assumptions.statement: Using SNS/SQS with an S3 archive would still require bespoke replay jobs per consumer, which is undesirable.
assumptions.quote: SNS/SQS with an S3 archive was rejected because replay would still be a bespoke job per consumer.
